title: Cross-browser wipe trial
subtitle: Does anything a card leaves behind in one browser ever show up in another, or come back in the same one?

header.label: Card B (a different card)
header.placeholder: Any other card, as different as possible

scenarios.title: Browser A, back out, Browser B
scenarios.intro: The iPad case as remembered: a card read in Browser A, no wipe, then Browser B opened fresh.

steps.text: In Browser A open the newest build from the versions page.
steps.expect: Welcome page shows (it always does: nothing is remembered).

steps.text: Set a PIN, add biometrics if offered, press START.
steps.expect: Lock is set; the camera card opens.

steps.text: Photograph Card A and accept the OCR result.
steps.expect: Fields show Card A's details, and only those.

steps.text: Do NOT wipe. Go back to the lab page with the browser's back button and choose Leave.
steps.expect: The Leave dialog appears; the lab versions page comes back.

steps.text: Switch to Browser B and open the same build.
steps.expect: Welcome page shows.

steps.text: Set a PIN and biometrics, press START, photograph Card B.
steps.expect: Camera works; a picture of Card B is taken.

steps.text: Accept the OCR result and read every field slowly.
steps.expect: Only Card B's details. Nothing from Card A (name, company, phone, email, address, logo).

steps.text: Open the Vault page and the 3D card: any logo, palette or Undo from Card A?
steps.expect: No.

scenarios.title: Browser A, wipe, Browser B
scenarios.intro: Same again, but Browser A is wiped properly before Browser B is opened.

steps.text: In Browser A open the build, set PIN and biometrics, photograph Card A, accept the OCR.
steps.expect: Card A's details fill the fields.

steps.text: Press Wipe, hold Yes for 1.5 seconds. Leave the settings box unticked.
steps.expect: Everything clears; the page reloads to the welcome page.

steps.text: Switch to Browser B, open the build, set PIN and biometrics, photograph Card B, accept.
steps.expect: Only Card B's details.

steps.text: Back in Browser A later: reload the page.
steps.expect: Welcome page, empty fields, no PIN remembered.

scenarios.title: Same browser, leave and come back
scenarios.intro: Does anything survive inside one browser across leaving, closing the tab, or reloading?

steps.text: In Browser A read Card A, then reload the page (pull down or the reload button).
steps.expect: Welcome page, empty fields.

steps.text: Read Card A again, then close the tab, then open the build in a new tab.
steps.expect: Welcome page, empty fields.

steps.text: Read Card A again, go back with the browser's back button, choose Leave, then press forward.
steps.expect: A toast says everything was wiped when you left; fields empty.

steps.text: Read Card A again, quit the browser app fully (swipe it away), reopen it and the tab.
steps.expect: Welcome page, empty fields.

scenarios.title: Lock, then the 7-minute wipe
scenarios.intro: Screen off or app switch locks the card. Seven minutes after the lock, everything is wiped.

steps.text: Read Card A in Browser A, then press the home button or switch to another app for about 30 seconds and come back.
steps.expect: The PIN screen (or fingerprint) asks before the card is shown again.

steps.text: Unlock with the PIN.
steps.expect: Card A's details are back.

steps.text: Lock again and stay away for more than 7 minutes (set a timer), then come back.
steps.expect: Everything was wiped: welcome page or empty capture card, no PIN.

steps.text: Try the fingerprint or face unlock once, then enter a wrong PIN 5 times in a fresh session.
steps.expect: Biometric opens the card; 5 wrong PINs wipe everything.

scenarios.title: Browser B first, then Browser A
scenarios.intro: The reverse direction, without and with a wipe.

steps.text: Read Card A in Browser B, back out without wiping, then read Card B in Browser A.
steps.expect: Only Card B's details in Browser A.

steps.text: Read Card A in Browser B, wipe, then read Card B in Browser A.
steps.expect: Only Card B's details in Browser A.

scenarios.title: The deciding control: Card A versus Card B
scenarios.intro: This is the one that settles the iPad case. Two different cards, two browsers, read letter by letter.

steps.text: Browser A: read Card A, accept, write down the first name, company and email exactly as shown.
steps.expect: Card A's details.

steps.text: Without wiping, Browser B: read Card B, accept.
steps.expect: Card B's details, letter for letter. Note any field that shows Card A.

steps.text: Now in Browser B photograph Card A on purpose and accept.
steps.expect: Card A's details appear, because Card A was just photographed. This is the harmless case that looks like a leak.

steps.text: Was any Card A text ever shown in Browser B before Card A was photographed there?
steps.expect: No. A Yes here is a real leak: write every field down in the notes.

scenarios.title: Settings cross-check
scenarios.intro: The one thing the app keeps is a tiny settings entry. It must stay inside one browser and survive a wipe unless asked to go.

steps.text: In Browser A switch the theme to light and the hand to left, then open Browser B.
steps.expect: Browser B is still dark and right-handed.

steps.text: In Browser A wipe with the settings box unticked.
steps.expect: Light theme and left hand are still there after the reload.

steps.text: In Browser A wipe again, tick 'Also delete my saved settings', confirm 'Are you sure?'.
steps.expect: Back to dark and right-handed.

steps.text: Use the lab's 'Start fresh' button, then open the build.
steps.expect: Defaults again; nothing else different from any other fresh visit.
